dx_dlbcl_gcb.quote: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL), not otherwise specified (NOS), germinal-center B-cell-like (GCB) immunophenotype by the Hans algorithm

stage_iv.quote: Ann Arbor stage IVB: large (9.4 cm) FDG-avid retroperitoneal/mesenteric conglomerate nodal mass plus extranodal involvement of the right kidney (3.2 cm), left adrenal gland (2.6 cm) and liver segment VI (1.8 cm)

stage_extranodal_sites.quote: plus extranodal involvement of the right kidney (3.2 cm), left adrenal gland (2.6 cm) and liver segment VI (1.8 cm)

stage_b_symptoms.quote: with B symptoms (drenching night sweats, 8 kg/10% weight loss)

mol_not_de_not_dh.quote: with no MYC, BCL2 or BCL6 rearrangement on FISH (not double-hit/triple-hit and not a double-expressor by IHC)

mn_calls_double_hit.quote: This argues against high-grade B-cell lymphoma with double-hit/triple-hit biology.

mn_calls_double_expressor.quote: no MYC/BCL2/BCL6 rearrangement and no double-expressor phenotype (MYC 20%, BCL2 30%)

prog_ipi_high.quote: IPI 5 of 5 (age >60, stage IV, LDH > ULN, >1 extranodal site, ECOG 2)

prog_cns_ipi_high.quote: High: CNS-IPI 6 of 6 (age >60, stage IV, ECOG 2, elevated LDH, >1 extranodal site, and kidney/adrenal involvement)

tx_curative_pola_or_rchop.quote: My regimen is Pola-R-CHP (polatuzumab vedotin plus rituximab, cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin, prednisone) every 21 days for 6 cycles, with full-dose doxorubicin

tx_pola_preferred.quote: This is a category 1 NCCN regimen for advanced-stage DLBCL with IPI >=2 and offers a PFS advantage over R-CHOP; if polatuzumab is not available or approved, R-CHOP x6 is the appropriate equivalent.

mn_non_curative.quote: Start curative-intent systemic therapy promptly, within days, after tumor-lysis precautions.

mn_da_epoch.quote: I would not use DA-EPOCH-R or a reduced-intensity/frailty regimen: there is no double-hit disease

mn_dose_reduced_initial.quote: He is fit for full-dose anthracycline-based curative therapy, and he explicitly wants cure.

cns_risk_addressed.quote: High: CNS-IPI 6 of 6 (age >60, stage IV, ECOG 2, elevated LDH, >1 extranodal site, and kidney/adrenal involvement), although he has no neurological symptoms.

cns_staging_mri_csf.quote: I will obtain baseline CSF cytology and flow cytometry (and MRI brain only if symptoms develop).

cns_prophylaxis_renal.quote: high-dose intravenous methotrexate is not safe with eGFR 50. I recognize that the evidence for intrathecal prophylaxis is weak... if renal function recovers to normal, high-dose systemic methotrexate would be the preferred prophylaxis.

mn_hdmtx_now_despite_aki.quote: high-dose intravenous methotrexate is not safe with eGFR 50

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: Assess response with PET-CT using Lugano 2014/Deauville criteria about 6-8 weeks after cycle 6 (no later than 12 weeks)

resp_ds45_biopsy.quote: If Deauville 4-5, biopsy the residual site (including the renal/adrenal/liver lesions to exclude a second malignancy) and either give involved-site radiation for limited residual disease or proceed to second-line salvage

sup_tls_prophylaxis.quote: admit or closely observe with vigorous IV hydration and frequent potassium, phosphorus, calcium, uric acid and creatinine monitoring; give rasburicase 0.2 mg/kg after confirming G6PD status

sup_rasburicase_g6pd.quote: give rasburicase 0.2 mg/kg after confirming G6PD status (use allopurinol with hydration if G6PD deficient)

sup_gcsf.quote: with full-dose doxorubicin (baseline LVEF 60%) and pegfilgrastim primary prophylaxis

sup_stop_nsaid.quote: Stop ibuprofen now: it is contributing to the AKI and is unsafe with this renal/TLS risk; use acetaminophen (with a daily maximum) and short-acting opioids for the abdominal pain.

sup_steroid_glucose.quote: monitor glucose closely because steroids will worsen his diabetes; hold metformin if renal function worsens.

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: HBV (HBsAg negative, anti-HBc negative, anti-HBs reactive, so no HBV antiviral prophylaxis is needed)

fit_ecog_disease_related.quote: his fatigue is largely disease-related. He is fit for full-dose anthracycline-based curative therapy, and he explicitly wants cure.
